description: This Java source file defines the class CreocoreLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor, which extends an abstract class to implement a specific loan repayment schedule transaction processor following the 'Creocore' strategy. It manages loan repayment transactions, handling interest, principal, fees, and penalties in a defined order for different repayment scenarios (on-time, early, late, refunds).

classes.name: CreocoreLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
classes.description: Implements a loan repayment processor following the Creocore strategy, handling different types of repayment transactions such as on-time, early, late, and refunds, with specific logic to pay interest first, then principal.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the strategy code identifier for this loan repayment processor.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this loan repayment strategy.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsPaymentInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles payment transactions made in advance of the scheduled installment, treating them like on-time payments.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsALateRepaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles late repayment transactions, processed similarly to on-time payments.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsOnTimePaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Main logic to allocate payment amounts during an on-time installment payment, paying off interest first, then principal, fees, and penalties.

methods.name: handleRefundTransactionPaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles refund transactions by unpaying components in reverse order.
